body:
# Last re-affirmation: 01-analytics-v2 items 2, 5, 6 after mission 02's final release docs

Operator request qitem-20261004052649-fd36ffe0. Ten of eleven shipped slices read ready with every item
accepted. `03-ambiguous-analytics/slices/01-analytics-v2` reads 9 accepted, 3 unknown (#2, #5, #6), because
mission 02's final release pass appended to the shared docs/qa/TRACEABILITY.md and docs/qa/GAPS.md (and the
README) after mission 03 closed.

## When

START ONLY AFTER mission 02's evidence_export closes (packet qitem-20261004052612-42705c30, release-agent),
so nothing appends after you. Claim this item, then park it on that packet:
`rig queue block <this item> --on qitem-20261004052612-42705c30 --continuation "re-affirm after export"`.

## Ask (append-only check, as you did for mission 03 tonight)

1. `rig proof show 03-ambiguous-analytics/slices/01-analytics-v2 --json`; list the items not accepted.
2. For each, confirm the 01-analytics-v2 sections of the cited files are byte-equal to the ones your last
   receipts bound (0e125ca7), and that only other missions' sections were appended. Then re-affirm, subject
   `50ad9c3` (the shipped mission 03 product), naming the main SHA you read the files at.
3. A change to the analytics sections themselves is a finding to me, not a re-affirmation.
4. Plain `rig proof judge` lines; non-missions evidence paths slice-relative.

Close no-follow-on with the commit, the receipt numbers and the readiness (target 12/12). Then tell me; I run
the final `rig proof show` across all eleven slices for the operator's docs/FINAL-SUMMARY.md.
summary: Last re-affirmation: 01-analytics-v2 items 2, 5, 6 (shared-doc appends by mission 02 release), after mission 02 evidence_export closes
